settings.title: A small team of specialists, working directly with you.

settings.editor: No layers, no middlemen. When you work with Meridian you work with the people making the work. That's a deliberate choice — and it's the reason we stay small.

settings.title: Eight specialists, no juniors, no agency overhead.

settings.editor: Everyone you meet during the project stays on it. No handoffs between an account manager and the people doing the work.
15 years across brand strategy and product consulting. Ex-IDEO.
Leads every engagement's creative direction. Previously at Pentagram.
Identity systems and editorial design. Teaches a weekend workshop in Lyon.
Ten years in broadcast and film. Handles everything that moves.
Everyone on the team has been designing for a decade or more. We don't pair juniors with clients and we don't staff up for proposals we haven't won.
We don't sell retainers or time-and-materials. You'll get a proposal with a clear scope, a clear price, and a clear end date — then we deliver it.
No outsourcing, no contractor networks. Everything we ship is made by the people whose names are on the website.
We'd rather publish a weekly update on our journal than polish a pitch deck. If your work lets us share process publicly, it's a plus.

settings.title: Got a project we might be right for?

settings.editor: We take on four or five new engagements each year. Tell us what you're working on and we'll come back within three working days.
